list.title: My Power Is Being a Magical Girl
list.synopsis:
Qiu An — male — possesses the ability of a magical girl.

Put simply, he can transform into a magical girl, or create completely different girls with distinct personalities and appearances in various locations as needed, even fabricating their backgrounds so they exist within recorded history.

Each of these girls is an extension of Qiu An’s consciousness — bodies he controls in perfect sync.

And thus… miracles descended.

At the peak of the world, a holy girl stood atop the clouds. With a wave of her hand, she summoned world-ending frost — giving rise to the legend of the Ice Queen.

In a city of vice, an enchanting witch wielded her staff. A single smile sent countless villains into a frenzy, willingly offering everything to her, their hearts swayed toward justice.

The clumsy white-haired loli, the angelic diva, the cool and noble big-sister type…

As more and more powerful magical girls emerged and revealed themselves as members of a mysterious organization, no one realized —
They were all Qiu An.

【One Soul, Many Bodies】

list.title: Transformed into a Magical Girl, but I Only Use Tentacle Magic
list.synopsis:
[Magical Girl] + [No Romance] + [Plot-Driven] + [Multiple Identities]

As the former top magical girl of the Moonlight Rank, Mandrake became a wanted fugitive of the Magical Court after being forced to kill a teammate during a mission.

Corrupted by the incident, most of her magic was rendered useless—leaving her with only an improper and indecent form of tentacle magic.

To evade capture, Nan Yuli abandoned her identity as a magical girl, blending completely into the mundane world of ordinary people.

That is, until one day, her little sister suddenly announced her dream of becoming a magical girl—and, to Nan Yuli's horror, seemed to be making real progress toward that goal.

At that moment, Nan Yuli panicked.

—Your big brother here is the Magical Court’s number one fugitive! If you become a magical girl, they're going to dig into my past and expose me! What am I supposed to do?!

—And why, at your age, are you so determined to pursue this career path?

—As someone who’s been through it, let me tell you—it's not great.

—What? You’re saying you only listen to Sister Mandrake?

—I f**king…

Thanks to her sister’s relentless efforts, Nan Yuli's true identity was finally exposed.

Cornered by former comrades and old friends, the sly and cunning girl could only put on a weak and helpless expression.

"You… What do you want? D-Don't touch my tentacles!"

list.title: After Becoming a Witch, I Went Wild in the Magical World
list.synopsis:
This world is totally insane.

There are gods who’ve lost themselves, witches who’ve stolen divinity, churches that claim to worship gods but secretly covet divine power, and nobles who appear honorable yet eat people alive behind closed doors.

The entire continent’s history can be summed up in one sentence: survival of the fittest, profit above all.

A girl from Earth named He Mu was reincarnated into this twisted world, becoming the new Lord of Heim.

Thankfully, the Transmigration Authority didn’t forget to issue her a cheat—thanks to the Trait System, she began her ascent to godhood step by step.

But who would’ve guessed—

The world’s calamity, the master of death, the Little Western Lord of Heim, the forever-loli Reaper, the legendary Death Witch—Hel Heim...

The thing she regrets most in this life is putting on that d*mn “Witch” trait with her own hands.
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Vol 3: Chapter 184: Research into Witch Bloodlines

list.title: A Magical Girl Won’t Become Her Witch Sister’s Plaything
list.synopsis:
[Magical Girl + Pure Yuri + Queen of a Thousand Girls]

A magical genius. A top student. The youngest graduate in the history of White Rose Academy.

As this legendary prodigy girl approaches graduation, the entire magical world eagerly awaits her next move.

And her decision is—

“I’m going back home to be a magical girl!”

The review board erupts in shock as the black-haired girl lifts her teacup, smiling with a practiced, professional charm.

“Protecting my hometown with my own magic has always been my dream.”

But in truth, what she's really thinking is—

Six years! It’s been six whole years since I got to snuggle with my sister! Even if I have to be her accessory, I’m sticking to her like glue!

Fueled by an overwhelming longing for her sister, the girl finally returns home—

Only to discover that the gentle, elegant sister from her memories…
…might be just a little different from what she imagined?

“Sis, you smell so nice~”
“Sis, your hands are so soft~”
“Wait… what do you mean ‘Sis, you’re actually a witch’???”

As the sweet mask her sister wears begins to crack, the genius girl's gaze slowly loses focus, and she lets out a scream of despair:

“Where the h**l did my sweet, gentle sister gooooo—?!”

list.title: Rebirth and Cultivation: Starting from the Womb in a Magical World
list.synopsis:
Luo Lin was one of the rare cultivators in modern society.
An accident caused his soul to transmigrate into a magical world—into the body of an unborn child.
His father was a king, his mother a royal consort, and his grandfather the vice dean of the Magic and Martial Arts Academy.
In this life, Luo Lin would begin cultivating from the womb, laying the foundation for an unmatched immortal path, steadily rising in strength, and dominating the magical world!
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Chapter 143: Azure Moon Continent's Most Powerful Two-headed Dragon Lizard

list.title: Apocalypse, Then I Became a Magical Girl
list.synopsis:
First Page of the Apocalypse Survival Handbook: Abandon morality and fantasies.
First Rule of the Magical Girl Code: Believe in bonds and hope.

A crimson storm that devours all reason tears open the sky. Terrifying monsters that feast on everything now roam the earth. Civilization collapses in an instant, and humanity loses its future.

And you—our tiny savior—your magical girl contract only lasts until adulthood, but you're already 17 years and 363 days old.

If that single glimmer of light… is the chance for a corporate slave like you to touch magic—
Then let the flood of elements burn away the twisted flesh. Let the symphony of magic break through the whispers of madness. Let solid walls fend off endless assaults, and let boundless courage rekindle the spark of order.

Return kindness with kindness, and repay evil with evil. Cast everything that doesn’t belong in this world back into the endless abyss.

This is the story of a hero.
This is the legend of a magical girl.

list.title: Postgrad Entrance Exam, Then I Became a Magical Girl
list.synopsis:
After failing the postgraduate entrance exam four times, Chen Qianmiao was completely disheartened. Just as he was falling into despair, he unexpectedly turned into a magical girl.

And becoming a magical girl comes with fulfilling one big wish of the girl.
Eliminate all suffering?
Make everyone happy?
Nope, his one and only wish—get accepted!

Of course, if he had a choice, he actually didn’t want to turn into a dude-version magical girl.
But magical girls are supposed to be cute and gentle, right?
So why...

The most vicious, most ruthless, most decisive, most anti-holy mother magical girl in history has arrived.

Cultists trying to summon an evil god? Kill!
Corrupted magical girls? Kill!
The evil god itself that could destroy the world? Kill!

If I don’t screw people over, they won’t screw me over?
Screw that! I’ll f**king kill! Kill! Kill!
If the bad guys aren’t wiped out, they’ll keep hurting the good ones!

Only with thunderous means can one show a compassionate heart!
If it can be killed, don’t try to reform it.
If it can be cut down, don’t drag it out.
The mission: speedrun evil!

Yeh! You’re taking the postgrad exam too? Sh** off!!!
Ribbit! It’s a magical girl, everyone run!!!

With his power alone, he flipped the whole magical girl stereotype on its head.
He’s absolutely unbeatable!

And his magical girl ability?
Each month, he randomly draws one fictional character’s skill.

The first character he drew... was Ryomen Sukuna!

When the 114,514th villain says “I’ll win for sure,”
When they shamelessly shout out their victory declarations,
Chen Qianmiao already knows—
It’s time.

list.title: The Magical Girl’s Kamen Rider Brother
list.synopsis:
Due to an accident, Tang Zijun was transported to a parallel world. Along with him came an unknown Kamen Rider belt. After discovering the strange "Mirror Dimension" lurking beneath this world, Tang Zijun spent several years alone wiping out all the monsters that inhabited it. At the same time, he gradually got used to his new identity.

Just as he was finally enjoying the peaceful life he'd longed for, Tang Zijun accidentally uncovered a secret about his little sister—she was actually a magical girl!

Could there be other factions in this world he didn’t know about? Were there evil monsters beyond those in the Mirror Dimension? Was he supposed to just stand by and watch his sister live the same perilous life he once did?

Faced with all this, Tang Zijun—who had retired as a Kamen Rider seven years ago—reluctantly picked up his belt once more.

“Don’t blame me. If you’re looking for someone to blame, blame yourselves for messing with the wrong guy.”
“Henshin!!”

list.title: Take Out a Loan, Then Become a Magical Girl
list.synopsis:
Qiu Bi looked at the girl and said, “Form a contract with me. All you have to do is give me your soul, and I’ll turn you into a magical girl.”

The girl was stunned. “I don’t have to repay a forty-year loan?”

“Nope.”

“I don’t have to use all my organs as collateral, and lose one every time I miss a payment?”

“Nope.”

“I don’t have to hand over all my future wages and just barely scrape by?”

“Nope.”

“I don’t have to sign a post-death contract, pledge my brain to you after I die, and get turned into a human crypto miner?”

“Nope.”

“Then what do we have to do?”

“Hahaha! I want you to work a full eight hours every day, only get two days off a week, have just two hours for lunch, and earn only triple pay for overtime! I’ll make you lose all hope in the world—and turn into witches!” Qiu Bi said viciously.

The girl looked at Qiu Bi, raised her hands in excitement, jumped up and down, eyes brimming with tears.

list.title: Survival for All: The Madman of the Magical Wasteland
list.synopsis:
【Original Magic Wasteland Survival, New Setting, New Shelter, No Cheats, Farming, No Female Lead, Has Pets, Grand Worldview, Disasters, Crafting, Transmigration, Game, Apocalypse】  

Everyone transmigrated to a magic wasteland world, starting with nothing but a magic tent.  

In this fantastical world, working at sunrise and resting at sunset has become the basic way of life for all.  

The skull of a towering beast, a dreamy conch house, an abandoned magic tower, a steam train traversing the void...  

The directions for upgrading shelters are endless!  

The surge of magic tides, the revival of ancient spells, the out-of-control ancient forbidden curses, the rampage of magical creatures...  

A series of apocalyptic disasters come one after another!  

A frozen land spanning ten thousand miles—an ancient forbidden curse!  
A canyon a thousand feet deep—the sword mark of a legend!  
A hundred-meter-long dragon and a knight crossing the storm...  

Will you struggle to survive, or forge a dazzling legend?  

It’s all up to you...  

Of course, first, you need to fill your stomach...

list.title: Failed to Retire — Now I’m a Magical Girl Again
list.synopsis:
[In this story, you’ll find the following elements—]
[Girl-centered / Intense physical affection / Hot-blooded shounen spirit / Love triangles / Femme fatales / Time loops]

“As long as I can make money, I’ll work overtime voluntarily.”

Former magical girl Lin Yuan, who needs a lot of money, retired and joined the logistics department.
However, due to the very nature of being a magical girl, she just couldn’t stay in the background as support forever.

A rookie magical girl — saved by Lin Yuan on their first meeting.
A teammate who became cold and distant after being forced to retire due to injury.
The red magical girl who always hides her true feelings behind jokes.
Her tsundere partner who, to the bitter end, never confessed her feelings.

The past Lin Yuan should’ve sealed away as a magical girl…
She worked overtime every day, trying to max out her contribution as a support staff member.

—That’s how it should have gone.

“Senpai, I… I have feelings for you…”
“Can’t you take better care of your body?”
“Rely on me more.”
“I’m sorry I lied. I love you.”

And everything began on the day that rookie magical girl appeared—

list.title: Starting From Magical Girl to Rule the Ages
list.synopsis:
Jiang Si wasn’t like other people. After ten years of devouring web novels, he never stopped believing that he too could walk the path of cultivation. Inspired by veteran web novel protagonists, he kept searching for a way to step onto that path.

Qigong, gene locks, magic, superpowers, zombie outbreaks... anything would do. As long as there was supernatural power, there had to be a road to the Dao. All power, in the end, should lead to cultivation.

Unfortunately, this world was plain and ordinary. There wasn’t a shred of supernatural power to be found.

Just as Jiang Si’s conviction began to waver, his truck finally arrived.

The world he transmigrated to wasn’t all that different in terms of daily life. But here, supernatural power existed.

Magical girls.

Though not quite what he had envisioned—and the power system of magical girls was nothing like those he’d read about before—it didn’t matter.

As long as it could help him step onto the path of cultivation, what did it matter if he had to become a magical girl?

Jiang Si was going to start his journey as a magical girl—and rule the ages!
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Final Grand Finale - Emperor Shion, Returns to the Mortal World!

list.title: Randy's Magical Adventure
list.synopsis: Randy, the weredog, becomes a full werewolf and gets in trouble for it. He and his dog friends from his first adventure then embark on a magical journey, solving riddles and gathering clues to find stone tablets containing magical spells that can tempt werewolves to dark deeds. One of which is the spell they need to make Randy a full werewolf forever. While Randy and his friends are on their journey, Randy's family sets out to find him and a way to change him back, because everyone misses him and the weredog he used to be.

list.title: My Superpower Is Piloting Magical Girl Corpses?
list.synopsis:
In this despair-filled alternate world, people possess all kinds of powers meant to save humanity.

Some transform into Ultraman and become beings of light.

Some become Kamen Riders and walk the path of heaven.

Some pilot giant robots and yell about forming the head.

But when Lin Guang looks at his own talent…

he falls silent.

What do you mean my superpower is:

[Piloting Magical Girl Corpses]?

So I’ve basically become Brain Monster now?

……

If you’re not ruthless, you won’t survive.

If you want to make it in this world, you have to be cruel enough.

For magical girls to rise to the top, they must not only be ruthless toward monsters—

they must be ruthless toward themselves as well.

You ask how ruthless I am to myself?

Heh.

I discarded my own magic core.

Two of them.

—

The strongest magical girl across both worlds.
The hidden chairman behind Organization L.
Honorary President of the Federal Witch Council.
S-rank Esper.
Holy Corpse Pilot.
Underground Emperor of the Secret Nation.
Incubator Hunter—

Lin Guang.
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Chapter 388: Supporting Neon City’s Magical Girl Endeavors Starts with You and Me

list.title: A Magical Girl Shouldn't Be a Blonde Evil Executive
list.synopsis:
My name is Ye Qing, and I am a senior executive of an evil organization.

As the head of the Hypnosis Department, my job is to brainwash magical girls.

That said, Ye Qing stared at the two magical girls standing before him.

Holding a hamburger in his left hand and a cola in his right, he sank into deep thought.

Seriously...

I don't even know hypnosis magic.

If I can't hypnotize magical girls, this wonderful career as a villain is going to slip away from me!

Please, someone save the magical girls already!

Little does he know that one of the prerequisites for becoming a magical girl is possessing a strong desire to help others.

list.title: Gunfire and Sword Strikes, Magical Girl
list.synopsis:
[Magical Girl] + [Gender Transformation into a Loli] + [Single Protagonist] + [Light Combat] + [Slice of Life] + [Light Novel] + [Daily Life]

The rating just came out. Since I couldn't find anything I wanted to read, I decided to write something myself.

"Why didn't you tell me before signing the contract that transformation requires wearing a skirt?"

"If I had, you wouldn't have signed."

"Then after transforming, what about my chest size—"

"You don't have one."

"..."

Chen De never imagined that, as a 175 cm high school boy, he would one day be tricked by a talking white cat into signing an irrevocable contract in a back alley and becoming the city's newest—

Magical Girl.

Every transformation shrinks him by twenty-five centimeters. The standard outfit includes a short skirt and knee-high socks. With a white blade in his left hand and a short firearm in his right, he hunts mysterious black creatures known as Calamities.

Defeating a Doom Calamity earns 40,000 (after commission deductions).

A Fierce Calamity is worth 120,000.

An Abyssal Calamity starts at 800,000.

Other magical girls fight to protect love and hope.

He does it to buy a better mattress.

"You are the first magical girl I've ever mentored whose first major purchase was a mattress."

"A mattress affects sleep. Sleep affects magical power recovery. Magical power recovery affects the next job. The logic is perfectly sound."

"..."

With talent five times greater than ordinary people, unusually stable mental health, and spending habits that make him an outlier among magical girls, Chen De gradually finds his transformed body becoming more feminine over time.

Thus, the genius magical girl Su Xi (Chen De) makes her grand debut.
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Chapter 339: I Said, We’re Having Hotpot!

list.title: Magical Alchemy: Rising after contracting with a monster.
list.synopsis:
Alchemists are a prestigious and rare profession, and to become a qualified alchemist, one must first be a wizard. Wizards themselves are a noble and scarce breed. However, when a soul filled with thoughts of AK-47, ballistic trajectories, landmines, skateboards, and other otaku concepts inhabits the body of the most humble and lowly of slaves, and this slave becomes an alchemist, it’s as if a bomb has been dropped into a lake, sending waves crashing across the world.

What’s even more surprising is that this guy not only refuses to follow the ancient traditions of alchemy passed down for thousands of years but also insists on creating outlandish inventions. The water-based magic potions he creates are completely revolutionary, turning centuries of alchemical history on its head, now reduced to tiny granules instead of the usual concoctions. As for his understanding of weapons and magic, it's equally unconventional: "Well, my weapon can directly eliminate your enemies right in your home—who needs a greatsword? And my magic cannon fires hundreds of fireballs in the time it takes you to cast one fireball spell, so who needs a staff? As for potions, it’s all about convenience and portability. But the most important thing is gold, gold, because only with enough gold can you buy all the things you need!” Kent shouted as he passionately defended his creations.
It all started with an accident and a contract with a magical monster...
